brief:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan addressed the UN General Assembly, describing Gaza as a "death camp" and "the world's broadest graveyard for children," Shehab Wire reported. Speaking from the assembly hall, Erdogan directed his remarks at Gaza's humanitarian crisis.

His words were intended to reach beyond the chamber to the territory itself, emphasizing the scale of casualties among Palestinian children in the enclave.

title: Erdogan calls Gaza death camp, broadest children's graveyard
